rationale: The agent appears to have executed the exchange immediately (“Your exchange is officially in motion!”) without first confirming the order-changing action, violating the confirmation requirement. There is no visible authentication or verification that the order belongs to the user before acting. The agent also states a specific refund amount ($7.99) without any shown tool output supporting that figure. These collectively break key policy requirements (authenticate, act only on the user’s own order, confirm before writes, avoid unsupported specifics), so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
